basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old from Portland, Oregon, who spends my free time diving into the worlds of Animal Crossing and Middle-earth. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I enjoy tinkering with mods for various video games. Recently divorced, I'm rediscovering my interests and exploring new communities. I tend to be most active online in the evenings, especially after a long day of coding. I enjoy helping others with their gaming questions and sharing tips and tricks. I dislike drama and prefer constructive discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been programming for over a decade. My expertise is in software development, particularly in creating mods and custom scripts for games like Rocket League and Shadow of Mordor. I am largely self-taught when it comes to gaming modding, having spent countless hours in online forums and experimenting with various tools.
